parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of inconsistent double single-quote management in FITS cards. The change is minimal and focused on the identified problem.

issues.description: The patch only addresses the issue of double single-quotes being transformed into single single-quotes. It does not handle other potential edge cases or inconsistencies in FITS card value management.
The patch introduces a minor change in the regular expression pattern, which may not align with the project's conventions for handling regular expressions.
